name: Postgres/SQLite Demo → File
description: Reads orders via postgres_source. In FORMULAETL_DEMO=1 this falls back to SQLite data/demo.db (or fixture rows) — not a live Postgres wire. Writes CSV + postgres_destination demo mirror.

config.query: SELECT order_id, customer_id, customer_name, email, product_sku, quantity, unit_price, order_date, status FROM orders

metadata.honesty: Demo uses SQLite under the hood; real Postgres needs DSN/credentials and FORMULAETL_DEMO=0
